The Discovery

Search. Discover.
Connect.

"Khoj" translates to "Search" or "Discovery". Our foundational narrative revolves around discovering happiness, slow moments, and deep connections while gazing at the endless horizon of the Arabian Sea.

We're more than a café—we're an experiential beachside social hub. Balancing the raw, organic energy of the Malabar coastline with the sleek comfort of modern café culture.

You don't just come back for food… you come back for the feeling.

"The sea whispers discoveries to those who pause to listen."
